title: AuthorDefeatParams
description:
`author.defeat` records a conditional attack against a supporting decision.
Defeating an attacker removes its effect; other live attacks may still block
the target.

claim_id.description: The stable claim id of the stored fact to defeat.

decision.description: The decision that defeats the claim.

defeated_decision.description: The claim's existing supporting decision to attack.

workspace.description: The authoring workspace whose lorestore is being updated.
